The '''2022 Cherwell District Council election''' was held on 5 May 2022 to elect members of [[Cherwell District Council]] in England.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cherwell.gov.uk/info/11/elections/890/elections-2022/4 |title=District Elections |access-date=10 May 2022 |work=Cherwell District Council}}</ref> This was on the same day as other [[2022 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]].
